text: A股军工板块逆势拉升，长城军工逼近涨停，航天南湖涨超13%，北方长龙、晟楠科技、国科军工、内蒙一机、建设工业等快速跟涨
text_en: A-share defense stocks bucked the trend, with Great Wall Military Industry nearing the daily limit, Aerospace Nanhu up more than 13%, and Northern Changlong, Shengnan Technology, Guoke Military Industry, Inner Mongolia First Machinery and Construction Industry rising quickly in sympathy
